{{Quote|Don't call me Doctor. You only get that honorific if you’re licensed to practice medicine.|Drikall Bessarah|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Drikall Bessarah''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the field [[Medic/Legends|medic]] of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit.<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he was assigned to [[Sharr Latt]]'s unit during the investigation into Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]'s involvement in the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]]. When Latt's and [[Bhindi Drayson]]'s units crossed paths on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]], the two units merged. During [[Siege of Mount Lyss Meteorological Station|siege]] of [[Mount Lyss Meteorological Station]], fellow Wraith [[Huhunna]] brought the wounded Drayson to Bessarah, who was the only field medic available at that time, after she had been shot by a [[Pop-Dogs]] trooper, a member of the elite Galactic Alliancce Army unit founded and led by Thaal. Despite his efforts, Bessarah was unable to save Drayson from her [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] wound, and she [[Death/Legends|died]].<ref name="MK" />

In addition to serving as Wraith Squadron's field medic, Bessarah also concocted various drugs that aided the squad's mission against Thaal, including a chemical capable of temporarily blinding members of the Pop-Dogs.<ref name="MK"  />
